entries.description: so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day
entries.subject: so woe

spans.text: [37] AR: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ EN: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.

[9] AR: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا EN: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.'

[21] AR: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا EN: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us.
[36] AR: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ EN: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him.
[13] AR: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا EN: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
[14] AR: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا EN: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.

folded.id: and he|has|made me blessed wherever i am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as i remain alive
folded.subject: And He
folded.object: made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive

spans.text: [31] AR: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا EN: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
[32] AR: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا EN: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
And it is a matter [already] decreed.'

folded.id: and peace|is|on me the day i was born and the day i will die and the day i am raised alive
folded.subject: And peace
folded.object: on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive

spans.text: [33] AR: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا EN: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
[27] AR: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا EN: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him.
[24] AR: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا EN: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

folded.id: came out|to|his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [allah] in the morning and afternoon
folded.subject: came out
folded.object: his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon

spans.text: [11] AR: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا EN: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.

folded.id: drove her|to|the trunk of a palm tree
folded.subject: drove her
folded.object: the trunk of a palm tree

spans.text: [23] AR: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا EN: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree.
[32] AR: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا EN: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
[35] AR: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ EN: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He!

[37] AR: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ EN: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
[10] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا EN: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign."

[5] AR: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا EN: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'

folded.id: he called|to|his lord a private supplication
folded.subject: he called

spans.text: [3] AR: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا EN: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.

folded.id: he|has|given me the scripture and made me a prophet
folded.subject: He
folded.object: given me the Scripture and made me a prophet

spans.text: He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy

folded.id: i have|a|boy when my wife has been barren and i have reached extreme old age?"
folded.subject: I have
folded.object: boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"

spans.text: [8] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا EN: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
[20] AR: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا EN: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
[17] AR: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا EN: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen.

folded.id: inherit me|and|inherit from the family of jacob
folded.subject: inherit me
folded.object: inherit from the family of Jacob

spans.text: [6] AR: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا EN: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob.

folded.id: it|is|not [befitting] for allah to take a son
folded.subject: It
folded.object: not [befitting] for Allah to take a son

spans.text: [35] AR: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ EN: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He!

folded.id: make him|a|sign to the people and a mercy from us
folded.subject: make him
folded.object: sign to the people and a mercy from Us

spans.text: [21] AR: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا EN: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us.
[18] AR: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا EN: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."

[4] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا EN: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

[4] AR: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا EN: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.

[5] AR: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا EN: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
We have not assigned to any before [this] name."

folded.id: represented himself|to|her as a well-proportioned man
folded.subject: represented himself

spans.text: Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
[29] AR: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا EN: So she pointed to him.

folded.id: she withdrew|from|her family to a place toward the east
folded.subject: she withdrew
folded.object: her family to a place toward the east

spans.text: [16] AR: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا EN: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

folded.id: she withdrew|with|him to a remote place
folded.subject: she withdrew

spans.text: [22] AR: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا EN: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

[26] AR: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا EN: So eat and drink and be contented.

folded.id: so woe|to|those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous day
folded.subject: so woe
folded.object: those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day

spans.text: [37] AR: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ EN: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'
That is a straight path."
[34] AR: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ EN: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
[12] AR: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا EN: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination."

folded.id: tidings of|a|boy whose name will be john
folded.subject: tidings of
folded.object: boy whose name will be John

spans.text: [7] AR: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا EN: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John.

folded.id: was born|and|the day he dies and the day he is raised alive
folded.subject: was born
folded.object: the day he dies and the day he is raised alive

spans.text: [15] AR: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا EN: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
[14] AR: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا EN: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
[28] AR: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا EN: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

folded.id: we speak|to|one who is in the cradle a child?"
folded.subject: we speak
folded.object: one who is in the cradle a child?"

spans.text: They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.'

folded.id: your lord|has|provided beneath you a stream
folded.subject: your Lord

spans.text: [24] AR: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا EN: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.

folded.id: your lord|to|give you [news of] a pure boy
folded.subject: your Lord
folded.object: give you [news of] a pure boy

spans.text: [19] AR: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا EN: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
[2] AR: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ EN: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah

folded.id: your sign|is|that you will not speak to the people for three nights
folded.subject: Your sign
folded.object: that you will not speak to the people for three nights

spans.text: He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
